s3_whisper_network.title: Whisper Network
s3_whisper_network._comment: Society line S3 (docs/story/society.md). Needs cond informant_alive (W1). Standing/transfer verbs live in quest_log region W2.

tip.text: The Informant's reports now name petition evidence. The Warden has adjusted the review date. Someone has been very helpful.

decoy.label: Feed him a decoy
decoy.text: A Clerk forges a convincing pile of nothing. The Warden files it under progress.
decoy.hint: Costs 5 parts, needs a Clerk. Petition fee x0.9 for 4 days.

bait.label: Bait the Warden
bait.text: You leave a trail of crumbs. Someone follows it. Possibly the wrong someone.
bait.hint: 50%: audit dates known, audit parts x0.8. Else petition fee x1.3 for 3 days.

cut.label: Cut him off
cut.text: Inmate tip received: 'They are counting plates.' Thank you for your service. He is transferred.
cut.hint: He leaves (transferred). His block loses Standing. Fee back to normal.
